consequence.statement: This is a testing infrastructure improvement with no operational consequence for Crossplane deployments or configurations.

original.statement: E2E test steps are automatically retried on failure; this is a testing infrastructure change with no impact on deployed Crossplane instances.

decision.reason: [ev-f3322dd7e7b5] only says that each E2E test step is now re-run automatically if it fails. That is a change to the project's own end-to-end test harness. Nothing in it touches a Crossplane API, setting, image or runtime behaviour that an operator deploys. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or changes for a running environment, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the evidence does not say outright that operators are unaffected; that conclusion is inferred from the change being test-only.
